title: Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and mitigating gender bias and stereotype-driven hallucinations in multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) interpreting economic roles in memes. While it discusses 'epistemic overcommitment' and 'epistemic restraint', these terms are used strictly in the context of evidential certainty and contextual sufficiency for machine learning inferences, not in the context of religious, moral, or philosophical epistemology. There is no evaluation of religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
